metadata.description: The vibe plugin: the skills, agents and guard that take a project from idea to delivered software, in any repository, with the Groundwork governance layer laid over a project only when its owner asks for it.

plugins.name: vibe
plugins.description: Thirteen skills (start, begin, scope, spec, stack, architect, design, verify, code-review, debug, deliver, maintain, comply) that lean on Claude Code's bundled /verify, /code-review and /security-review for the running and the bug hunt, three review agents on Sonnet, and the guard that refuses a bypassed gate or a force-push before it runs.
